one_liner_zh: 卡特彼勒上季財報表現強勁，受惠於強大的需求與定價能力，每股盈餘與營收皆大幅優於市場預期。
one_liner_en: Caterpillar reported strong quarterly earnings, significantly beating estimates on both EPS and revenue driven by robust demand and pricing power.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，每股盈餘 8.17 美元顯著高於預期的 6.20 美元。
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘達 8.17 美元，大幅優於市場預期的 6.20 美元。
季度營收達 20.54 億美元，年增率高達 23.98%。
展現出色的營運韌性與強健的定價能力。
受惠於全球工業與基礎建設需求持續熱絡。
highlights_en: EPS of $8.17 significantly outperformed the estimated $6.20.
Quarterly revenue reached $20.54 billion, representing a 23.98% year-over-year increase.
Demonstrated strong operational resilience and robust pricing power.
Benefited from sustained global demand in industrial and infrastructure sectors.
risks_zh: 全球總體經濟放緩可能對未來設備需求造成壓力。
供應鏈成本波動及通膨壓力可能侵蝕利潤率。
risks_en: Global macroeconomic slowdown could pressure future equipment demand.
Supply chain cost volatility and inflationary pressures may erode margins.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：本次財報展現優異的獲利能力與超預期的成長動能，釋出正面訊號。對股價中短期具備明顯支撐作用。追蹤指標應關注全球基礎建設支出走勢、原物料成本變動及接單能見度。
ai_view_en: view: The earnings report delivered positive signals with exceptional profitability and growth momentum, providing solid near-to-mid term support for the stock price. Key metrics to track include global infrastructure spending trends, raw material cost fluctuations, and order backlog visibility.
